name: Riad Apps
subtitle: Private native tools for Leon's devices.
description: Signed, immutable iPhone and iPad releases of Base and Riad.

apps.name: Base
apps.subtitle: Talk to your agents from iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Base is the native Riad client for following sessions, dictating prompts, and sending messages to your agents.

versions.localizedDescription: Recovers Anthropic usage from healthy fleet peers and compacts the expanded 280-point sidebar so every GPU and token status fits.
Stabilizes OMP working-state italics across redraws, fixes macOS ownership-graph arrows, assigns all GPC chats to HATT, and dismisses the iPhone/iPad keyboard before opening the graph.
Make iPad connection recovery independent of Tailscale path callbacks: retry failed routes on foreground activation, use fresh health and SSE sessions, and cap visible retry backoff at eight seconds.
Prevent stale /btw overlays from reappearing after daemon restarts. Add base create with automatic ownership, automatic sidebar hiding, rollback safety, and owner data in list output.
Preserve Hatt activity timestamps, keep Base hosts distinct by raw daemon identity, repair stale iPhone fleet seeds, and make macOS daemon installation machine-aware.
Fixes iOS send acknowledgement recovery and repeated rows, isolates /btw from the transcript cursor, and routes mobile dictation through the Mac mini Scribe service.

Emergency Apple-client rollback to the field-verified 0.3.21 implementation after 0.3.22 regressions. Restores compact mode, GPU and token status, multi-window restart restoration, sharp SwiftMath output, and durable optimistic sent messages while retaining the daemon and deployment cleanup.

Integrates the validated cleanup branch: full daemon/API security and lifecycle cleanup, bounded transcript caches, fixed Shift-Return insertion, complete long-message display up to the hard safety cap, and translucency limited to Base's background while foreground controls remain solid.

Keeps translucency behind Base's content while foreground controls remain solid. Long and structurally dense transcript rows now render fully without per-message Show full message controls. Mac Shift-Return inserts exactly one newline; Return still sends. The existing hard payload cap and render fence remain in place.

Moves translucency behind Base's content. Foreground text, navigation, selection, dictation, and composer controls remain solid and plain; supported system themes use native thin material only as the pane backdrop. Super Dark and the disabled setting remain opaque.
Liquid Glass groups now use adaptive regular platters for readable contrast, while nested controls remain translucent and the primary action uses the system prominent style.

Liquid Glass controls now use visibly translucent clear native surfaces with a restrained adaptive contrast scrim across iPhone, iPad, and macOS. The Appearance toggle still restores the original flat controls.
Native Liquid Glass now styles Base's navigation and composer controls on iPhone, iPad, and macOS 26, with an Appearance setting to switch back to the flat controls.
Markdown tables remain one aligned grid on iPhone, iPad, and Mac; wide tables scroll horizontally instead of splitting into row cards.
Captures completed OMP /btw replies in Base transcripts, restores OpenCode SQLite parsing, and bottom-aligns hidden-chat disclosure controls.
Tucks each per-host hidden-chat arrow into that host’s final visible session row, eliminating all disclosure-only vertical space.
Makes each per-host hidden-chat arrow compact and trailing-aligned, reclaiming sidebar space without changing its behavior.
Adds per-host hidden-chat disclosure arrows while preserving the global reveal control, and keeps selected Frequent duplicates gray in their original host.
Restores iPad fleet connectivity on iPhone Personal Hotspot by restarting stale network routes immediately and bounding Tailscale health probes.
Prefers healthy fleet usage reports over broken snapshots, improves on-device dictation quality and cleanup, and preserves structured Anthropic refusal status.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Base records audio for dictation and transcribes it on your Mac Mini when available or on this device.

apps.name: Riad
apps.subtitle: Home server, private dictation, and briefing.
apps.localizedDescription: Riad is the native client for the mini's private dashboard, service controls, news and morning briefing, and Scribe dictation through the Mac mini's local WhisperKit model.

versions.localizedDescription: Make integrated Scribe visible in persistent navigation, deep-link App Shortcuts directly into recording, stop dashboard setup from blocking dictation, and omit the SideStore-incompatible widget extension.
Restores private Scribe connectivity through the Base tailnet proxy and adds a one-tap Control Center dictation control on iOS 18 and later.
Folds Scribe into Riad: private foreground dictation through the Mac mini, Dictate with Riad shortcut activation, explicit Copy and Share, and one combined SideStore install.
Winds in Marina: two-column medium, direction column dropped for space.
Winds in Marina: today's forecast from 8am and the next three days (large widget).
Winds in Marina widget: mph, altitude rows, cleaner layout.
Winds in Marina: mph, altitude rows, cleaner layout.
Show the installed build in connection settings; KOAR winds widget.
KOAR winds-aloft widget: surface, 925, 850, 700 hPa from GFS, home screen and Lock Screen families.
Tighter oasis icon: palm cluster centered.
Oasis app icon from the real photograph, replacing the glass glyph.
First Riad release: Base-style minimal UI, briefing, news digests, service controls, and this update channel.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Riad records voice for its Scribe page, then sends the recording over your private Tailscale network to your Mac mini for local transcription.
